messages:
Alex (CS): FYI: batch embedding indexing stalled for some Dedicated and Private tenants in APAC starting ~02:40 UTC. Affects search and similarity during onboarding. Drafting customer note + mitigation plan.
Noor (Eng): We're seeing a spike in memory pressure in the embed-indexer job after a config change. Rolling back and restarting the pipeline now.
PagerBot: Rollback initiated: job/embed-indexer v3.5.0 -> v3.4.7. Status: running restart.
Jin (Support): Could we offer an interim workaround customers can apply to surface partial search results? I can include steps in the Intercom thread.
Noor (Eng): Yes — temporary workaround: reduce batch_size to 64 and enable local fallback ranking. I'll paste the command.
Noor (Eng): Command: `REDWOOD_BATCH=64 ./indexer --fallback-ranking`
Alex (CS): Draft short message for customers: "We identified an issue that temporarily delayed embedding indexing for some APAC Dedicated and Private tenants. Engineers have reverted the change and indexing is resuming. We are prioritizing tenants onboarding now and will share an RCA shortly. If you need immediate assistance, book a specialist slot or request a manual reindex."
Carlos (I18n): I can localize the short message into zh, ko, and ja. ETA 20m. Any legal constraints on credit language?
BillingBot: Suggested credit template: "A one-time account credit proportional to affected indexing time will be provided to impacted tenants upon request."
Alex (CS): Ok to use that template. Keep it opt-in to avoid over-crediting. We'll proactively offer to high-touch customers.
Jin (Support): Please attach the manual reindex request form link: https://support.redwood.ai/reindex-request and I'll route responses to the oncall queue.
Noor (Eng): Restart finished. Embedding queues draining. Estimated catch-up: 34 hours for largest tenants, most catch up within 4590 minutes.
PagerBot: Post-rollback healthcheck: embed-indexer: healthy, cpu 35%, mem 61%, queue depth decreasing.
Alex (CS): I'll segment affected tenants by tier and send the short update + offer for manual reindex/office hours. Who can sign off on the Intercom copy?
Carlos (I18n): Translations ready for zh/ko/ja. Pasted drafts in thread.
Jin (Support): I can send Intercom to affected Standard and Enterprise segments once Alex approves. Also will attach KB steps for the local workaround.
Alex (CS): Approving send now. Include manual reindex link and billing credit wording. Use the subject line: "Update on indexing delay affecting APAC tenants"
Jin (Support): Sent to segmented intercom audience. Will monitor replies and escalate any exec-level concerns.
Noor (Eng): After-action items: add mem-pressure alert on embed-indexer, add pre-merge test for batch config, and a fast-path manual reindex API for CS.
Alex (CS): Renewal-risk note: flag any trial or near-renewal tenants experiencing >48h onboarding impact. Jin, can you export that list and ping respective CSMs?
Jin (Support): On it. Export link: https://drive.redwood.ai/incidents/4898765432/impacted_list.csv
Alex (CS): Thanks. Also we'll offer a dedicated office hours block tomorrow 08:00 UTC for affected APAC customers. Add cal link: https://cal.com/redwood-apac-indexing-help
BillingBot: Credit PR created and queued for review by finance.
Alex (CS): Closing loop here. Will paste RCA link when Noor finishes the postmortem. Thanks team for quick rollback and communications.
